messages:
liz_sales: Hey team — quick heads up. Prospect (Mid-market fintech in EU) wants a 6-month hybrid POC: VPC/private control plane + occasional burst to hosted. They asked if we can reduce the on-prem/platform fee for the POC window and include premium support for the trial period.

omar_eng: Do we have the technical constraints documented for hybrid routing? iirc we can route traffic to hosted fallbacks but need a signed MOU for data residency. :thinking_face:

liz_sales: Yep — they require data-at-rest in their cloud, KMS integration, and an offline installer for air-gapped inference nodes. They've asked for a single line item in the quote: "VPC Platform Fee (6mo POC)"—asking for 50% off list. Current list is $50k/yr PF.

natalie_security: For KMS + offline installer we need to confirm HSM compatibility and create an exception for remote telemetry. I'll need them to fill out our lightweight security addendum and return before infra access. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.example/security-poc-q

sam_dealdesk: Curious on economics — are they committing any GPU spend? Deal desk prefers amortizing platform fee if there's a commit. If it's purely evaluation with <$10k committed GPU, the platform fee discount needs manager approval.

liz_sales: They can commit to ~$8k/mo of GPU for the POC (estimated). Proposal from me: bill platform fee as a 6-month SKU at $25k (i.e., 50% annualized), include 24/7 premium support for POC (trial level) at no extra charge, and require a PO + signed MOU.

tess_finance: If we do $25k PF for 6 months and estimate $48k GPU usage total, contribution margin is thin but acceptable for net-new strategic vertical. We need to flag revenue recognition and ensure PO up front. Finance asks for invoicing schedule: full PF upfront or 50/50?

liz_sales: Customer prefers upfront for PF. We can accept upfront net-30 PO. Can deal desk approve the PF credit and the free support add-on for a one-time POC only? Also need SKU code to create quote.

sam_dealdesk: Approve in principle but need manager ok for the 50% concession and free premium support. Please provide the exact quote line items and commitment language. I'll escalate after that.

omar_eng: Quick tech note to include in the MOU: "hybrid routing fallback to Redwood-hosted inference is allowed only for non-PII requests; any PII must be served on-customer infrastructure. KMS integration must support AES-256 and customer-managed keys." Add clause for telemetry: "minimal health metadata only, togglable on request."

liz_sales: Adding that language. Draft quote lines below:

- SKU: 3P-VPC-PF-6M — VPC Platform Fee (6 months) — $25,000 — billed upfront
- SKU: 3P-VPC-GPU-COMMIT-6M — Estimated GPU usage — $48,000 — billed monthly
- Support: POC Premium Support (6 months) — $0 (one-time trial)

sam_dealdesk: Good. Two asks: 1) Include a one-time waiver clause: "platform fee credit applies only to initial POC term and is non-recurring"; 2) Legal needs a short SOW snippet referencing infra access, KMS, and telemetry opt-out. If both present, I can sign off and route to manager.

natalie_security: I'll review the SOW snippet once legal drafts it. Also require the completed security questionnaire before any private control plane provisioning.

tess_finance: Finance confirms: accept upfront PF invoice net-30, GPU billed monthly. We'll need the PO number on the invoice and revenue bucket flag set to "POC - non-recurring adjustment".

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: confirm offline installer packaging, k8s manifests & helm chart version, and customer acceptance test (CAT) plan included in SOW.

liz_sales: Thanks — I'll update the quote and SOW with the items above and ping @sam_dealdesk for final approval. Will also attach the security questionnaire for the customer to complete. :thumbsup:

sam_dealdesk: @liz_sales once you post the final quote and SOW here I'll push to manager for the 50% concession approval.

liz_sales: Posted updated bundle link: https://redwood.example/quotes/1923456789 (quote + SOW + security checklist). Moving to manager now.

sam_dealdesk: Received. Escalating to manager. Expect reply within 24h. :eyes:

liz_sales: Great — flagging the customer ask: prefer contract signing by end of month to align with their infra window. I'll follow up on the questionnaire.
